verses.saheeh: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
verses.khattab: ˹At least˺ for ˹the favour of˺ making Quraysh habitually secure—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[In gratitude] for the security of Quraysh,

verses.saheeh: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
verses.khattab: secure in their trading caravan ˹to Yemen˺ in the winter and ˹Syria˺ in the summer—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿their security (īlāfihim: repeated for emphasis; it is a verbal noun from [the verb] ālafa) for the journey of winter, to Yemen, and, the journey, of summer, to Syria, every year: they made use of these two journeys to provide for their trade at the station [of Abraham] in Mecca, in order to attend to the House [of God], which was their source of pride; they [Quraysh] were the descendants of al-Nadr b. Kināna;
verses.romanUrdu: (yani) Jaadey(winter) aur garmi ke safaron se manoos

verses.saheeh: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
verses.khattab: let them worship the Lord of this ˹Sacred˺ House
verses.jalalayn: ﻿let them worship (fa’l-ya‘budū is semantically connected to li-ilāfi, ‘for the security’, the fā’ being extra) the Lord of this House,
verses.romanUrdu: Lihaza un ko chahiye ke is ghar ke Rubb ki ibadat karein

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
verses.indopak: الَّذِىْۤ اَطْعَمَهُمْ مِّنْ جُوْعٍ ۙ وَّاٰمَنَهُمْ مِّنْ خَوْفٍ
verses.transliteration: allathee at'amahum min joo'in waamanahum min khawfin
verses.saheeh: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
verses.khattab: Who has fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Who has fed them against, that is, on account of, hunger and made them secure from, that is, on account of, fear: they used to suffer hunger in Mecca due to the lack of crops and they feared the army of the Elephant.
verses.romanUrdu: Jisne unhein bhook se bacha kar khane ko diya aur khauf se bacha kar aman ata kiya
